title: Suspicious DLL Loading via Rundll32
id: 4d6a915f-57b1-4be4-a9f7-d9805ba8611c
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious DLL being loaded via rundll32 from temp directory
references:

author: SOC Automation Team
date: 2026/04/10
modified: 2026/04/10
tags:

    - selection

        - ImageLoaded|contains|all:
            - '\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\'

        - not ImageLoaded|contains: '\\Windows\\System32\'
    - and:
        - not ImageLoaded|contains: '\\Program Files\'
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate applications loading DLLs from temp
level: high
